'''Pratari Cinn''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[black marketeer]] operating in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Parmel sector/Legends|Parmel sector]] by [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. He gained a reputation for the fast pace at which he moved his goods. Around 10 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]], Cinn was documented on a [[TracSheet]] file used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which listed several of his crimes, including the sale of illegal [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]], possession and distribution of illegal goods, violations of customs excise laws, and more.

==Biography==
Pratari Cinn was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]]<ref name="GG11" /> around [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]]. By [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> he had become a [[black marketeer]] operating in the [[Parmel sector/Legends|Parmel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Twi'lek gained contacts among the various [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] guilds in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and made sure to involve himself in mostly anything that went through the sector. Cinn garnered a reputation for moving goods at a faster pace than all of his competitors, concluding the deals with minimal hindering. The Twi'lek also insulated himself with a large number of his intermediary contacts and preferred high-ticket goods with low chances of delay.<ref name="GG11" /> It was rumored that he maintained several facilities in uncharted [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|belts]] where "better merchandise" was stored.<ref name="GG11" />

In approximately 10 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> when he was thirty-three years old, Cinn was documented on a [[TracSheet]] document used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], where he was labeled as "Subject: 89906544-TRHH-965777." His listed charges and specifications included the illegal possession of restricted [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]], the sale of illegal weaponry, possession and distribution of illegal goods, violations of customs excise laws, and the aiding and abetting of known smugglers. Other listed details included his description, operative norms, trademark dealing, and a statement on file.<ref name="GG11" />

==Personality and traits==
Cinn, a [[Color/Legends|red]]-eyed Twi'lek with a muscular build, stood at 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. He sported a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] scar across his left cheek. Cinn had never been convicted of a violent crime, though his henchmen had a careless zeal for carrying out Cinn's interests.<ref name="GG11" />

==Skills and abilities==
The Twi'lek, like other members of his [[Species/Legends|species]], could use his<ref name="GG11" /> [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]]<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> [[Limb/Legends|head-tails]] to communicate secretly with other Twi'leks. Cinn had the skills of security, [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle operation, and pickpocketing. Survival in urban environments, black market operations, street knowledge, and value were all topics Cinn was informed about. When dealing with other beings, he would bargain, con, and sneak around. The Twi'lek could put blasters to use and dodged in combat.<ref name="GG11" />

==Equipment==
Cinn wielded a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] and a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. He also made use of a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and had a variable amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Large reserves of some type of [[Currency/Legends|currency]] were also available to him. At some point in his life, he wore several [[Piercing/Legends|earrings]] on his left [[Ear/Legends|ear]] and a multi-colored [[Clothing/Legends|top]].<ref name="GG11" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pratari Cinn was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', a [[1994]] supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The [[West End Games]]-published book was written by [[Rick D. Stuart]], and the image featuring Cinn was illustrated by [[Mike Vilardi]].<ref name="GG11" />
